vulnerability.title: The Postfix package is installed
vulnerability.description: A mail server is required for sending emails. The postfix package can be installed with the following command: $ sudo dnf install postfix
vulnerability.recommendation: Remediation script: # Remediation is applicable only in certain platforms if rpm --quiet -q kernel-core; then if ! rpm -q --quiet "postfix" ; then dnf install -y "postfix" fi else >&2 echo 'Remediation is not applicable, nothing was done' fi

triage_decision.reason: Installing the postfix package is a straightforward package installation that does not affect authentication, authorization, or critical system services. The remediation script simply installs the package if absent, posing minimal risk of lockout or system breakage.
triage_decision.estimated_impact: networking affected; Enabling a mail service may expose the system to network traffic if not properly configured; Potential for misuse if the mail server is left open to the internet
